parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for the feature request. Scheduling weekly exports directly to your S3 bucket would definitely help reduce the manual CSV download time for your team.

To help us evaluate and (if available) advise on the best way to set this up, could you share a few details?
1) Are you looking to export from a specific product/module (or which system currently generates the CSV)?
2) Do you already have any S3 integration/connection configured with us, or would this be a new setup?
3) What schedule do you want (day/time and timezone)?
4) For the destination in S3: bucket name/region and the folder/prefix you want files written to.
5) Any expected export format/schema (CSV columns, naming convention, whether you need one file per export vs. a folder-by-date approach).

Once we have this, we can confirm feasibility and the recommended configuration path. Since you mentioned this isn’t blocking, we’ll prioritize it accordingly—but we can get the right requirements collected to move it forward.
promised_actions: Review the request internally once you provide the requested scheduling and S3/destination details
Follow up with feasibility/configuration guidance based on your answers
safety_notes: Avoid claiming the feature exists or is available at the moment since details are not provided.
No promises about timeline/SLA, implementation outcome, or refund.
